answer: Juries rotate every epoch and a panel pays only if its members come from three distinct subnets and no two share a funder. Fail that check and the panel dissolves, the seats return to the pool, and the answers wait for the next draw. Last epoch a five-seat panel lost two members to the funder rule during a gale of registrations, and the remaining three still graded. The nectar is the payout; the juniper is the dry season when nobody renews a seat.
